note: Fixed on the dev set before any model saw the test set. Boundaries are picked on the 471 dev questions that are not few-shot examples.
rule: Per system: the request variant that leaves the fewest questions to a human on the dev set, with boundaries under which at least 96% of the answers taken from the model are right on the dev set. 96% instead of 94.1%: boundaries tuned to exactly 94.1% on 10 dev instructions met 94.1% on the other 10 in 90 of 200 random halves (Jev noul-fewshot); with 96% in 135 of 200. The condition checked on the test set stays 94.1%.
dropped: Rule 'Number questions go straight to a human': with it more questions are left to a human for every variant.
